about: Mary Anne curates a 60 minute guest mix.

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 28 Dec. This December, Queermas returns to BBC Radio 6 Music, taking over the 6 Mix airwaves with some of our favourite LGBTQ+ artists, featuring exclusive hour-long mixes from across the LGBTQ+ community. A much-loved annual 6 Music tradition, Queermas shines a spotlight on LGBTQ+ voices and talent during the festive season, inviting artists, DJs and selectors to curate their own special mixes and soundtracks for the holidays. First up we are joined by DJ and producer BASHKKA, who has just released her debut EP for fabric Originals, CORE, shaped by a return to her musical…
items.title: Queermas takeover with BASHKKA

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 25 Jan. The Cure frontman Robert Smith takes over the 6 Mix ahead of his 'Cureation' of this year's Teenage Cancer Trust concerts at the Royal Albert Hall, featuring Elbow, My Bloody Valentine and Mogwai amongst others. The 6 Mix is the new flagship mix on BBC Radio 6 Music, curated by Mary Anne Hobbs. Each week, Mary Anne Hobbs introduces a one-hour mix from a past, present or future icon of electronic music - artists, DJs, labels, and clubs. Others who have played mixes for Mary Anne in the past include: Four Tet, SHERELLE, Helena Hauff, Blawan, Goldie, Chloé Robinson, R…
items.title: Robert Smith from The Cure

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 21 Dec. We welcome Paleman to the 6 Mix. Hailing from Manchester, he's a jazz drummer turned mercurial electronic producer whose restless approach to rhythm and sound has made him one of the UK's most distinctive underground voices. Fresh from a new release on Interplanetary Criminal's ATW label, Paleman gives us a snapshot of what he's been playing out on dance floors. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: Paleman

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 14 Dec. Manami is a DJ, producer and pianist born in Tokyo, raised in the UK, based in Bristol. She plays music inspired by her diverse upbringing and classical training. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: Manami

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 3 Dec. Broadcast in tribute to The Godfather of Techno, Juan Atkins. This is another chance to hear his 6 Mix from 2013. Atkins was widely regarded as one of the originators of Techno music, along with Derrick May and Kevin Saunderson. The trio, often referred to as the Belleville Three, attended high school together in Belleville, Michigan, near Detroit. Growing up, they all regularly tuned in to DJ Charles 'The Electrifying Mojo' Johnson's radio show, which has been cited as a big influence on their musical development. items.title: In tribute to Juan Atkins

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 30 Nov. Glasgow techno pioneers Slam, aka Stuart McMillan and Orde Meikle, are in the 6 Mix celebrating 35 years of Soma Records ahead of the release of their Soma 35.4 Activate Remixes featuring Luke Slater, Oscar Mulero, Phil Berg and Nastia Reigel. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: Slam
